# Getting help

Payverge is community-maintained. Maintainers and other users answer questions
in public, on a best-effort basis. There is no support SLA.

## Where to ask

| You have… | Go to |
| --- | --- |
| A question about installing, configuring, self-hosting or using Payverge | [GitHub Discussions, Q&A](https://github.com/stdevMac/payverge/discussions) |
| An idea, or a feature you want to talk through | [GitHub Discussions, Ideas](https://github.com/stdevMac/payverge/discussions) |
| Something you built with Payverge, such as a deployment, fork or integration | [GitHub Discussions, Show and tell](https://github.com/stdevMac/payverge/discussions) |
| A reproducible bug | [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/stdevMac/payverge/issues/new/choose), using the bug form |
| A concrete, scoped feature proposal | [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/stdevMac/payverge/issues/new/choose), using the feature form |
| A security vulnerability | **Not in public.** See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) |
| A Code of Conduct concern | See [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) |

Issues are for bugs and agreed work. Questions opened as issues will be moved to
Discussions.

## Before you ask

1. Read the [README](../README.md) and the guides under [`docs/`](../docs/).
2. Search [existing Discussions](https://github.com/stdevMac/payverge/discussions)
   and [issues](https://github.com/stdevMac/payverge/issues?q=is%3Aissue), open
   and closed.
3. Make sure you are on the [latest release](https://github.com/stdevMac/payverge/releases).

## What to include

- The Payverge version (release tag or commit SHA) and how you deployed it
  (Docker Compose, a source build, or something else).
- What you expected to happen, and what happened instead.
- Relevant backend or frontend logs. Backend responses carry an `X-Request-Id`
  header; include it so the matching log lines can be found.
- **Redact secrets and personal data** first: API keys, tokens, passwords,
  guest names, emails and phone numbers.

## Guaranteed response times

This repository comes with no commercial support. If you need guaranteed
response times, hire someone who knows the stack. The license allows it.
